user.title: Connect to FlightSeats.io
user.description: Enter your FlightSeats.io API key. Checking it uses one request from your daily allowance. After setup, add watches from the integration page.

data_description.api_key: Create a key in the API Access section of your FlightSeats.io dashboard. It starts with fs_live_.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate FlightSeats.io
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Enter a new key.

reconfigure.title: Replace the API key

data_description.api_key: Create a key in the API Access section of your FlightSeats.io dashboard. It starts with fs_live_.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check it and try again.
error.not_gold: This account is not on an active FlightSeats.io Gold plan, which the API requires.
error.rate_limited: FlightSeats.io says the request limit has been reached. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach FlightSeats.io. Check your network connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

user.title: Add a watch
user.description: Other watches already use about {used} of {allowed} requests a day. The allowance is shared with the FlightSeats.io site and any other project using the key.

data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the route, e.g. SYD → LAX BUS.
data_description.programs: Qantas, Virgin Australia Velocity, or both.
data_description.origins: Pick one or more airports, or type any 3-letter code.
data_description.destinations: Pick one or more airports, or type any 3-letter code.

filters.name: Filters
filters.description: Which fares count as a match.

data_description.min_seats: Fares need at least this many seats (Qantas up to 6, Velocity up to 9).
data_description.max_points: Optional. Ignore fares above this many points.
data_description.reward_only: Classic reward fares only. Turn off to include fares such as Classic Plus.

dates.name: Date window (optional)
dates.description: Leave everything empty to search the program's full horizon.

data_description.days_ahead: A rolling window from today. Use this or the two dates, not both.
data_description.date_from: Start of a fixed departure window.
data_description.date_to: End of a fixed departure window.

schedule.name: Schedule and alerts
schedule.description: How often to check and how quiet to keep alerts.

data_description.interval_hours: Each check uses one request from the shared 200 a day.
data_description.cooldown_hours: A seat that vanishes and returns within this time does not alert twice.

error.too_many_seats: None of the chosen programs allows that many seats.
error.invalid_codes: Enter between 1 and 30 three-letter airport codes, separated by commas.
error.date_conflict: Use either days ahead or the from/to dates, not both.
error.date_order: The to date must not be before the from date.
error.window_in_past: The to date has already passed.
error.too_many_permutations: Origins × destinations × days is over the API limit of 10,000. Use fewer airports or a shorter window.

not_gold.message: The FlightSeats.io account is not on an active Gold plan.

quota_low.message: Only {remaining} requests are left today, which is below the safety reserve. Try again after the daily reset.

rate_limited.message: FlightSeats.io says the request limit has been reached.

not_loaded.message: FlightSeats.io is not set up or has not finished loading.

invalid_codes.message: Origins and destinations must each be 1 to 30 three-letter airport codes.

not_gold.title: FlightSeats.io needs a Gold plan
not_gold.description: FlightSeats.io refused the request because the account is not on an active Gold plan. Upgrade the plan or replace the API key with one from a Gold account. This repair clears itself after the next successful check.

search.name: Search
search.description: Searches cached reward seat availability once and returns the flights. Uses one request from the daily allowance.

origins.name: Origins
origins.description: Airport codes separated by commas, e.g. SYD, MEL.

destinations.name: Destinations
destinations.description: Airport codes separated by commas, e.g. LAX.

date_from.name: From date
date_from.description: Start of the departure window. Defaults to today.

date_to.name: To date
date_to.description: End of the departure window. Defaults to the program's search horizon.

seats.name: Minimum seats
seats.description: Only fares with at least this many seats.
